title: Autonomous closed-loop discovery of organic laser materials
abstract: We present a self-driving laboratory that combines robotic synthesis with Bayesian optimization to autonomously discover organic laser materials. The platform performs closed-loop experimentation across thousands of candidate molecules.
authors: Alan Aspuru-Guzik; Jane Doe; Bo Li
affiliations: University of Toronto; University of Toronto; MIT
keywords: self-driving lab; Bayesian optimization; materials discovery

title: Bayesian optimization for catalyst screening
abstract: This work applies Bayesian optimization to accelerate catalyst screening for CO2 reduction. We integrate the optimizer with a high-throughput experimental platform.

title: Graph neural networks for protein folding
abstract: We propose a graph neural network architecture for predicting protein 3D structures, trained on AlphaFold-derived data.
keywords: graph neural networks; protein folding; deep learning

title: Workflow orchestration for autonomous chemistry labs
abstract: We describe a software framework for orchestrating multi-instrument workflows in autonomous chemistry laboratories. The framework supports closed-loop campaigns and reproducible automation.
authors: Yiming Chen; Aspuru-Guzik, Alán; Roboto Bot
keywords: lab automation; workflow orchestration; scientific software

title: Active learning for molecular property prediction
abstract: Active learning strategies are applied to reduce labeling cost in molecular property prediction. We benchmark on QM9 and a custom dataset.

title: Self-driving laboratory for thin-film photovoltaics
abstract: A self-driving laboratory autonomously synthesizes and characterizes thin-film perovskite solar cells. The system uses closed-loop optimization to maximize stability.
authors: Helena García; Curtis Berlinguette; Jane Doe
affiliations: University of British Columbia; UBC; University of Toronto

title: A survey on transformers for natural language processing
abstract: This survey reviews transformer architectures for NLP tasks, including BERT, GPT, and T5 variants.

title: Robotic automation in pharmaceutical compound screening
abstract: We describe a robotic platform for high-throughput pharmaceutical compound screening with on-line UV/Vis readout.

title: Closed-loop optimization of electrochemical synthesis at UofT
abstract: This study integrates a robotic electrochemistry platform with Bayesian optimization for autonomous synthesis at the University of Toronto. The closed-loop campaign explored thousands of conditions.
keywords: closed-loop; electrochemistry; Bayesian optimization; self-driving lab

title: A review of climate models
abstract: A broad review of climate modeling approaches and their use in IPCC reports.

title: Surrogate models for chemical reactivity prediction
abstract: We benchmark surrogate models for chemical reactivity prediction across a wide variety of organic transformations. No autonomous platform is described in this work.
authors: Jane Doe; Bo Li; Sara Müller
affiliations: University of Toronto; MIT; ETH Zurich
